page.overview:
Who is Cathy Bowman?

Cathy Bowman is a little girl who appeared in .

Cathy Bowman was the excited young girl who explored the beach on Isla Sorna. She was portrayed as a British girl coming from a wealthy family that was vacationing on a yacht cruise. As she wandered throughout the beach, she came upon a Compsognathus. When she went to feed the Compsognathus a little piece of her food, the others suddenly came out from the grass, had surrounded and had attacked her. Her parents, Paul and Deirdre Bowman, and the crew of their yacht heard her screams and ran to her aid. It was revealed by John Hammond that Cathy had survived the attack. During a InGen's boarding meeting, the pictures of the incident were shown, and her parents were described as "wealthy, angry, and litigious", hinting at a possible lawsuit against InGen.
